mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 1.04% is historically low, and historically, such low rates have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of time periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 1.04%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of time periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a strong economic environment that supports positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of time periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5 and UNRATE < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of time periods when HOUST is below 1000.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 4.4% is low, and historically, low unemployment rates have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of time periods when UNRATE is at or below 4.4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of time periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and high retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) signals a strong consumer demand environment that supports positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of time periods when HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a supply shock or economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of time periods when INDPRO is below 100.
